intitule: Giving Instructions: Explaining How to Use an App

enonce.texte: You want to teach your grandmother how to use a video calling app (like WhatsApp or Zoom) to see her grandchildren. Write a clear set of instructions.

questions.texte: Write a simple, step-by-step guide. Use the imperative form (e.g., 'Open the app', 'Tap the icon').
questions.reponse: Example: 1. Open the app on your phone. 2. Find the contact name and tap it. 3. Tap the video camera icon to start the call.

intitule: Discussion: Advantages and Disadvantages of Technology

enonce.texte: Read the opinions below and then participate in a discussion or write your own paragraph using logical connectors to express your opinion.

questions.texte: Discuss or write about the advantages and disadvantages of using social media.
questions.reponse: Example: Social media is useful because it helps us stay in touch with friends and family. However, it can be addictive and waste a lot of time. Also, some people share too much personal information.

images: A screenshot of an Instagram post description: 'Loved the new restaurant downtown! The food was amazing, so we will definitely come back. However, it was a bit expensive, but the service was perfect!'

questions.texte: Identify the logical connectors and explain how they help to structure the opinion.
questions.reponse:
1. 'so' - indicates a result (food amazing -> result: we will come back).
2. 'however' - introduces a contrasting idea (food amazing but it was expensive).
3. 'but' - introduces another contrasting idea within the same sentence.
